notes.title: 🌟 Defendópolis - Beta Release Now Live! 🌟
notes.notes:
[h2][b]📢 Defendópolis - Beta Version Now Available! 📢[/b][/h2]
We are thrilled to finally release the [b]Beta version of Defendópolis[/b] to our community! 🎉 This is your chance to experience the game before the full release.




[h3]🔍 [b]What to Expect in this Beta Version:[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]Full gameplay experience with the first [b]10 waves of enemies[/b].[/*]
    [*][b]3 types of enemies[/b] with unique abilities and challenges.[/*]
    [*]A robust tower-building system to defend your village.[/*]
[/list]

[h3]💡 [b]What We Need from You:[/b][/h3]

Share your impressions, report bugs, and provide suggestions for improvements.


Join the discussions on our [b]Steam Community[/b] to help us create the best possible version!




[h3]⚙️ [b]What's Next?[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]New enemies, towers, and balance tweaks in future updates.[/*]
    [*]Continuous improvements based on your feedback for an even more thrilling experience.[/*]
[/list]


🔗 [b]Join our journey, become a defender of Defendópolis, and help us improve the game![/b]


We greatly appreciate everyone who joins us from the start. Let’s build the future of Defendópolis together! 🚀
